title: Beyond Retrieval: Joint Supervision and Multimodal Document Ranking for Textbook Question Answering
abstract: arXiv:2505.13520v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Textbook question answering (TQA) is a complex task, requiring the interpretation of complex multimodal context. Although recent advances have improved overall performance, they often encounter difficulties in educational settings where accurate semantic alignment and task-specific document retrieval are essential. In this paper, we propose a novel approach to multimodal textbook question answering by introducing a mechanism for enhancing semantic representations through multi-objective joint training. Our model, Joint Embedding Training With Ranking Supervision for Textbook Question Answering (JETRTQA), is a multimodal learning framework built on a retriever--generator architecture that uses a retrieval-augmented generation setup, in which a multimodal large language model generates answers. translated_title: 超越检索：面向教科书问答的联合监督与多模态文档排序
translated_abstract: 教科书问答是一项复杂的任务，需要理解复杂的多模态上下文。尽管近期的技术进展提升了整体性能，但在教育场景中，这些方法在精确语义对齐和任务特定文档检索方面常常面临困难。本文提出了一种新颖的多模态教科书问答方法，通过引入多目标联合训练机制来增强语义表示。我们的模型JETRTQA（基于排序监督的联合嵌入训练教科书问答）是一个建立在检索器-生成器架构之上的多模态学习框架，采用检索增强生成设置，由多模态大语言模型生成答案。JETRTQA旨在提高复杂教育环境中检索文档的相关性。与传统的直接评分方法不同……
tldr: 提出JETRTQA框架，通过多目标联合训练和排序监督来增强语义表示，从而改进复杂教育场景下多模态文档检索的相关性，提升教科书问答的性能。
